picks.note: Micah Parsons trade: Green Bay sent its 2026 and 2027 first-round picks and Kenny Clark to Dallas.
Sauce Gardner trade: Indianapolis sent its 2026 and 2027 first-round picks and Adonai Mitchell to the Jets.
Myles Garrett trade: the Rams sent their 2027 first-round pick, a 2028 second, a 2029 third and Jared Verse to Cleveland.

choices.note: Quinnen Williams trade: the Jets get the earlier of Dallas's two 2027 first-round picks (its own and Green Bay's); Dallas keeps the other.
